title: Bound and no-follow all vector generator check reads
description: Modified generator --check paths in test/vectors/generate_authenticated_schc_dio.py, generate_packets_timing.py, generate_announce_signed_data.py, generate_ipv6_addresses.py, generate_dao_origin_signature.py and related generators use Path.read_bytes/read_text without O_NOFOLLOW, ownership/type checks, stable snapshot checks, or a byte limit. A symlink or oversized canonical artifact can make a read-only determinism check follow an unintended file or exhaust memory. Add one shared bounded no-follow exact snapshot reader in atomic_json.py, use it for every generator check, and test symlink, nonregular, concurrent growth/change, and oversized artifacts while preserving zero-write --check behavior.
